messages.MESSAGE: Coffee spelt backwards is...eeffoc...which is funny, because until I've had my coffee, I don't give eeffoc about anything.

In a statement from Ijesa Dynamics CEO Allie Grosset, the company has announced that it is opening a new production plant in [nation]Italian Dutch[/nation] in partnership with the nations government. The plant is expected to be tooled to produce a licensed export version of the MRAV Caracal (Multi-Role Armored Vehicle), the MRAV Cougar. While building new factories in nations simply to sell vehicles is rare, political and economic experts expect this deal is another step by the Italian government to pull the conflicted nation out of its current economic conundrum between its THEP allies and the EDU aligned WMW company as well as combating unemployment. 

This deal isnt too surprising however, with the Lavian government aligning itself with the THEP alliance, even receiving a permanent invitation from the alliance although not joining due to certain economic policies. This deal will expand the ULRs influence in East Shamat and loosen EDU grip on Italian Dutch for the time being. 

MRAV Cougar basic specs:
Cost per unit: $1.6M

Wheels: 6x6

Armament: Modular RFS mount allowing for the standard mounting of a MT-10 13.2mm heavy machine gun or a JE-I612 20mm cannon. The RF system also allows for the mounting of other armament if the country wishes to use weapons already in their stock.

Max speed: 55mph/88.5kph

Armor: STANAG 4569 Level 4 armor protection as well as bullet proof windows capable of stopping rounds up to and including 14.5mm, able to be increased via additional armor

Max capacity: 2 crew (gunner/commander, driver), 8 passengers
